checks.title: Gate B rule m3_no_fragments
checks.warn_text: There are no floating fragments, holes or broken thin parts.

checks.title: Gate B rule m3_sides_match
checks.warn_text: The rendered side and back views match the approved views.

checks.title: Gate B rule m3_texture_clean
checks.warn_text: The surface colours are clean and flat, without smears, baked shine or dark blotches.

checks.title: Gate B rule mv_back_plausible
checks.warn_text: The back view is a believable back of the front design (no face, no front print showing through).

checks.title: Gate B rule mv_no_new_parts
checks.warn_text: No view adds parts that are absent from the front view and plausible from the concept.

checks.title: Gate B rule mv_same_object
checks.warn_text: All four views show the same object (or hairstyle) with the same parts, colours and proportions.

checks.title: Gate B rule mv_view_direction
checks.warn_text: In the {view} image, the object's front faces the image's {expected} side.

checks.title: Gate B rule pr_flat_front
checks.warn_text: The graphic is flat, straight-on artwork, not drawn on clothing or in perspective.

checks.title: Gate B rule pr_matches_concept
checks.warn_text: The graphic matches the print in the reference crop in motif and colours.

checks.title: Gate B rule pr_motif_matches
checks.warn_text: The graphic depicts {motif}.

checks.title: Gate B rule pr_readable_small
checks.warn_text: At this small size (the 100-px version), the motif is still recognisable.

checks.title: Gate B rule pr_single_graphic
checks.warn_text: Exactly one graphic is shown, whole and centred, with empty space around it.

checks.title: Gate B rule rs_not_copied
checks.warn_text: The candidate does not reproduce the reference's specific outfit, print, hairstyle or character; shared general style is fine.

checks.title: Gate B rule sh_outline_kept
checks.warn_text: The grey panel keeps exactly the same outline as the input.

checks.title: Gate B rule sh_soft_folds
checks.warn_text: The shading shows a few large soft folds, not busy wrinkles.
